# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Repository | Version | Supported |
|-|-|-|
| app | 0.0.x | True |
| css | 0.1.x | True |
| context-engine | 0.1.x | True |
| flair | 0.1.x | True |
| rectgrid | 0.4.x | True |
| rectgrid | < 0.4 | False |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report a vulnerability via below URL:

https://github.com/animagram-jp/app/security/advisories/new
